provenance.dataset: FORCE 2020 machine learning competition well logs
provenance.notes: Offline data audit only. No train/test split selection, no statistics fitting beyond counts/min/max, no model training or evaluation. Label histograms are dataset audit counts, not held-out model evaluation; any split must be frozen later and independently of outcomes. Row-level values are not included; histogram keys are exact numeric values and the declared NULL sentinel appears under its own key.
